sections.heading: Best-Value Activities in Queenstown
sections.body:
Queenstown offers a wide range of activities for families, including the Skyline Gondola and Luge, Ziptrek Ecotours, and Queenstown Ice Arena. The TSS Earnslaw Steamship is a great option for families with younger children, while the Kjet / Dart River Jet is perfect for older kids and teenagers.

For free activities, head to the Queenstown Gardens, play frisbee golf, or take a walk along the Lake Wakatipu foreshore. The Kelvin Heights Peninsula loop walk is a hidden gem, offering stunning lake views with almost no tourists.
list: Skyline Gondola and Luge: $40-$60 per person
Kjet / Dart River Jet: $80-$120 per person

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Families
sections.body:
To save money on your Queenstown family holiday, consider booking activities and accommodation outside of peak season. Look for package deals that include activities and accommodation, and take advantage of free activities such as the Queenstown Gardens and Lake Wakatipu foreshore walk.

Here are some additional money-saving tips:
list: Book activities and accommodation outside of peak season
Look for package deals that include activities and accommodation
Take advantage of free activities such as the Queenstown Gardens and Lake Wakatipu foreshore walk
Use public transport or walk instead of driving
Buy snacks and groceries instead of eating out for every meal
Consider a campervan holiday instead of booking a motel or hotel

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices on activities and accommodation in Queenstown, it's essential to book in advance. For peak season (December to February), book at least 2-3 months in advance to avoid high prices and availability issues.

For off-peak season (April to November), book at least 1-2 months in advance to get the best deals. Keep an eye on Bookme.co.nz for last-minute discounts and special offers.
